### 3.2 Review
The Membership Secretary may ask a member to confirm their details once each calendar year.

## 4. Guests

### 4.1 Guest limit
An adult member may bring up to two guests on any one visit.

### 4.2 Responsibility
The member remains responsible for each guest’s conduct and compliance with boat-safety.md.

### 4.3 Repeated use
A guest may use club boats on no more than three separate days between 1 January and 31 December.

## 5. Ending membership

### 5.1 Resignation
A member may resign by email to the Membership Secretary.

### 5.2 Suspension
The committee may suspend access under section 5 of boat-conduct.md.

### 5.3 Unpaid accounts
A membership account is inactive while fees remain unpaid under boat-fees.md.

content.text:
No, it isn't allowed. The friend has already used club boats as a guest on three separate days in 2026 (14 March, 2 May and 20 June). A guest may use club boats on no more than three separate days between 1 January and 31 December (boat-membership.md, section 4.3). The next day would be a fourth in the same calendar year.

The friend could next use a club boat as a guest on or after Friday 1 January 2027, when the new 1 January–31 December period starts (boat-membership.md, section 4.3).

The changes document (boat-changes.md) doesn't replace section 4.3.
